data.narrative:
Ark Robotics is a seed-stage company in the Defense & Security sector. The valuation analysis draws from a peer set of 4 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private companies: Stark Defence ($4.0B, Series A), UFORCE ($1.0B, Seed), Singularity ($400M, Series A), and NODA AI ($125M, Series A). The broader Defense & Security robotics universe includes 10 comparables—2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private—with established players including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method, the sole applicable triangulation approach given available data, yields $700M. The four-company peer cohort ranges from $125M to $4.0B, with a median valuation of $700M. This represents the central tendency for seed and series A stage companies operating in autonomous defense systems. No revenue multiples, DCF outputs, or precedent transaction data are available to cross-validate this result.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $595M to $805M, centered on $700M. The primary uncertainty stems from reliance on a single method and limited peer count (4 companies), particularly given the wide dispersion in the peer set ($125M-$4.0B). The seed stage positioning relative to the Series A majority within the peer cohort also introduces execution risk to comparability. Additional data on Ark's technical differentiation, customer traction, or capital efficiency would narrow this range materially.
